items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Ronnell Bright (I think he was working with her), to come and fill in. So I go play with her.

ctx.x: Sarah Vaughan's bass player was in an automobile accident or something, and I got a last-minute call from I guess, Ronnell Bright (I think he was working with her), to come and fill in. So I go play with her. And in the audience later is Joe Glaser. So he saw me up there, and he said, 'There's that crazy son-of-a-bitch. I can't pay him to... He's crazy. I tried to make him famous, and he turned me down.' So I guess he thought I was a nut. But I've always felt like if they want me, well, give me some money.…
